item.title: Colts make key hires amid NFL scouting combine
item.description: The Indianapolis Colts have hired Marion Hobby (pictured) as their defensive line coach and Kalon Humphries as assistant defensive line coach, as well as announcing other coaching and staff moves amid the NFL's annual scouting combine.

item.title: Warming back up into midweek with more chances for rain and snow | Feb. 23, 2026
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — After back-to-back days of being trapped back into a winter conundrum with cold and snow, we’ll see warmer air push back into our region. item.title: Sewer rates to increase in Speedway to fund plant upgrades
item.description: The Speedway town government has moved forward with a state-mandated $15 million to $18 million expansion of its wastewater treatment plant. The project will result in higher monthly bills for the utility's customers, town leaders say.

item.title: Driver arrested after hitting sheriff’s SUV at crash scene on icy U.S. 31
item.description: A Marshall County deputy's SUV was struck by a van Monday morning on an icy U.S. 31 while responding to a separate crash south of Plymouth. Indiana State Police say the van's driver was arrested for not having a driver's license.

item.title: ‘I will carry him with me every day’: Joshua Shrum remembers best friend, Officer Brian Elliott
item.description: Hundreds of people attended the funeral of Beech Grove police officer Brian Elliott, who was killed in the line of duty, to pay their respects and hear eulogies from his colleagues and friends.

item.title: Indianapolis father and girlfriend sentenced to 30 years for boy’s death
item.description: An Indianapolis father, Kevin Gavarrete, 27, and his girlfriend, Julia Sizemore, 22, were sentenced to 30 years in prison for their roles in the starvation and abuse death of a 7-year-old boy in 2024.

item.title: Indiana House approves stricter SNAP and Medicaid requirements, checks
item.description: The Indiana House passed Senate Bill 1, which sets income limits and immigration status requirements for SNAP, bans purchasing candy or sugary drinks with SNAP benefits, and sets immigration status checks for Medicaid.

item.title: State of the Union will go out to changed nation, sidelined Congress
item.description: Donald Trump will deliver his annual State of the Union address on Tuesday night to a nation experiencing significant changes. The Republican president has executed a head-spinning agenda that includes upending priorities at home, shattering alliances abroad, and challenging the nation’s foundational system of checks and balances.

item.title: Indiana National Guard officer accepts invite to Trump’s State of the Union
item.description: 1st Lt. Kathryn Quarcelino of the Indiana National Guard has accepted an invitation from U.S. Rep. Jefferson Shreve, an Indiana Republican, to attend President Trump's State of the Union address.

item.title: Midwest couple experiences tense situation as Mexico cartel violence grows
item.description: Rosanne and Tom Hlava are among U.S. citizens in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, who are being urged to shelter in place due to widespread violence from a cartel following the killing of a major drug lord. They shared with News 8 what they're seeing.
